text: こんなんじゃ　トレーナータワーは　おあずけかなあ

structure.en: will have to wait, I guess

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the casual form of では, here meaning 'if things are like this', with a bad result following. こんなんじゃ = 'with things like this'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end, here drawn out as かなあ, shows the speaker wondering to himself. おあずけかなあ = 'I guess it'll have to wait'.
